hypothesis: Onset support localization exceeds space-time IoU; first-arrival hazard can improve timing
features: unchanged causal555; no oracle shift, no future labels/quality/coverage as inputs
target: hazard at each +5..+30 conditional on all previous eligible future frames observed nonqueue; first missing/low-quality censors risk set
queue_probability: 1-product(1-hazard through h); persistence approximation, no claim of calibrated hazard under informative missingness
per_road_fit_gate: >=50 known first-arrival rows and >=90% complete positive link windows still queued at +30
control: R10 expanded original queue-target probes200 at same555features; baseline full R15
training_months: June-November; temporal probe June-September and October-November holdout
selection: December phase-balanced >=4/phase, mean gain>=.004 and worst phase>=-.015; alpha .5/1
January: global blend0/.5/1 only; original thresholds frozen
Ongoing: R15 entire probability and threshold unchanged
